personality_one_liner: A high-contrast, tactile, and highly legible business-professional tool built for industrial field reference.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for readability in the field. Large 48pt tap targets for lists and buttons to accommodate gloved/busy hands.

do's: Use over hero images for back buttons
Use on sticky filter/segment bars when scrolling through location documentation
dont's: Do not use on generic list items or form inputs to maintain high-contrast readability

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Provides a top-level entry point to the terminal zones (Zeekade, Middenveld, etc.), search, and the Plattegrond.
screens.layout: Hero image of the port terminal at the top with a gradient scrim and the app title. Below, a global Search bar. Then, a Miller-column style drill-down list (Stack navigation) for the root folders: Plattegrond, Zeekade, Middenveld, Binnenkade, D-banden, K-banden, TLS, Rijdend materieel. Each list item has a ChevronRight icon and a generous 56pt height.

screens.name: Location Detail
screens.purpose: Displays reference documentation, photos, and PDFs for a specific location node, plus access to faults/checklists.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty folder. Text: 'Geen documentatie gevonden voor deze locatie.'

screens.layout: Header with the location name (e.g., 'C11 en WC12'). Sticky segmented control underneath: [Informatie] [Storingen] [Checklists]. Informatie tab shows rich text, image thumbnails, and PDF row links. Storingen tab lists recorded faults. Checklists lists available checklists. A sticky floating action button (FAB) at the bottom to add a new Storing or Checklist.

screens.name: Plattegrond Viewer
screens.purpose: A dedicated full-screen viewer for the terminal floorplan with pinch-to-zoom capabilities.

states.loading: Centered spinner over a dark background.
states.empty: Upload prompt: 'Geen plattegrond geüpload. Tik om toe te voegen.'

screens.layout: Full-bleed image viewer. Glassmorphism back button floating at the top left (respecting safe area). If empty, shows a large upload dropzone.

screens.name: Storing Toevoegen
screens.purpose: Form to register a new fault (Storing) for a location.

states.loading: Form disabled with a submit spinner.

screens.layout: Standard iOS-native form. Single column. Label above input. Fields for Description, Photo upload (grid), and Status. Sticky primary CTA 'Opslaan' at the bottom inside KeyboardAvoidingView.

home_hero.alt: Cargo ship at a port terminal dock

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow '1 iOS-Native Clean' principles. Keep the UI extremely tactile and high-contrast, representing a 'zakelijk' (business) terminal tool.
BANNED COLORS STRICTLY ENFORCED: Do not use any blue, indigo, violet, purple, or navy. Use the designated Signal Orange (#EA580C) as the primary brand/action color against white/gray surfaces.

Navigation should use Stack navigation (drill-down list pattern). Do not use deep accordion trees on a single screen as it clutters mobile real estate. Clicking a folder (e.g., Zeekade) pushes a new screen with its sub-folders (A1, A4, etc.).
List items must be at least 56pt tall with 44pt+ touch targets to accommodate field workers.
In Location Detail, use a Segmented Control to switch between Informatie, Storingen, and Checklists. Keep the FAB sticky at the bottom for quick 'Add Fault' actions.
Apply a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to dark) over the home_hero image behind any overlaid text to guarantee contrast.
Ensure Dutch language is used everywhere as requested (Informatie, Storingen, Checklists, Opslaan, Plattegrond).
